remarks: Bright, spacious, and newly renovated - this 3-level 2/3 bedroom townhouse rental in Stamford's Glenbrook neighborhood offers comfort, flexibility, and convenience. The upper level features two generously sized bedrooms filled with natural light, a full bath, and a versatile third room perfect for a home office, nursery, or guest space. The main level welcomes you with an oversized living and dining area, ideal for entertaining, with sliding doors leading to a private patio for seamless indoor-outdoor living. The kitchen, updated in 2024, includes stainless steel appliances and ample cabinet space. The main level also features a convenient powder room for guests. The fully finished lower level adds valuable living space, a laundry area, and endless possibilities - media room, gym, playroom, or all of the above. And an attic provides a hideaway for any storage needs. An added benefit of this home is the spacious backyard. Yours to enjoy hours of fun in the sun, a quiet cup of tea and a book, or a nice designated play area. Here you will have walkable access to the Glenbrook train station, you are just minutes away from the Noroton Heights train station, along with Darien shopping and dining...not to mention I-95. Ready to move-in and make it yours? Don't wait.... schedule a private tour today - this one won't last.
